dailyset_SidePanel_HowItWorksBody:
How to complete this activity:
  1. Complete all three Daily Set activities each day to earn points
  2. To finish the level up, keep the streak going for seven consecutive days
  3. If you skip a day, your streak will reset and you will have to start again
dailyset_SidePanel_Subtitle: To level up, complete the Daily Set 7 days in a row
dailyset_Title: Complete the Daily Set for 7 days in a row
dailystreaks_bing_SidePanel_HowItWorksBo:
How to complete this activity:
  1. Go to Bing.com and log in with your Microsoft Rewards account
  2. Search on Bing three times each day
  3. The activity is completed once you have searched for seven days in a row
  4. If you skip a day, your streak will reset and you'll need to start over
dailystreaks_bing_SidePanel_Subtitle: To level-up, search on Bing 3 times for 7 days
dailystreaks_bing_Title: Search with Bing for 7 days in a row
dailystreaks_mobile_SidePanel_HowItWorks:
How to complete this activity:
  1. Download the Bing app and log in with your Microsoft Rewards account
  2. Navigate to the Rewards section
  3. Tap on the current day in the "Check in" section
  4. The activity is completed once you have checked in for 7 days in a row
  5. If you skip a day, your streak will reset and you'll need to start over
dailystreaks_mobile_SidePanel_Subtitle: To level-up, check in to the Bing app for 7 days
dailystreaks_mobile_Title: Check in to Bing app for 7 days in a row
dse_SidePanel_HowItWorksBody:
How to complete this activity:On Microsoft Edge:
  • Go to Settings
  • Search for “search engine” in the “Search settings” box
  • Click on “Search and connected experiences”
  • Click on “Address bar and search”
  • Choose Bing in the dropdown against “Search engine used in the address bar”
On Google Chrome:
  • Go to Settings
  • Click the “Search engine” tab
  • Click “Change” button under Search Engine and select “Microsoft Bing”
On your mobile device:
  • Go to Settings
  • Search for the word “search”
  • Change the provider to Bing/Microsoft Bing under the address bar search settings
To complete this activity, keep Bing as your default search engine and search for 14 days in a month
dse_SidePanel_Subtitle: To level-up, use Microsoft Bing as your default search engine and search for 14 days
dse_Title: Set Bing as your default search engine for 14 days

How to complete this activity:
  1. Get a one-month Xbox Game Pass Ultimate with your Microsoft Rewards account
  2. The activity is completed once the subscription is activated
  3. If you already have a Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, the activity is automatically completed
